Nestled in the tranquil community of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, Driftwood Place offers an ideal retreat for those seeking peace, relaxation, and a place to reset. Located just off scenic Highway 30A, this serene beach house is a short, scenic walk to deeded beach access and one block from the heated (winter-spring) community pool. Designed to sleep up to 8 guests, Driftwood Place combines spaciousness with a cozy charm, featuring an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area perfect for gathering with loved ones. Unwind in the newly added master suite, a true haven that includes a private sitting area, work desk (for those who need a quiet corner to stay connected), and a morning kitchen for the perfect start to each day. Each of the three bathrooms has been tastefully renovated with soothing, modern finishes, including fresh tile, glass shower enclosures, and sleek chrome fixtures. Start your mornings on the large screened porch, breathing in the ocean air with a cup of coffee, or end your evenings under the stars. Driftwood Place provides two bicycles, a charcoal grill, and beach essentials, including chairs, a wagon, and beach toys for effortless days by the shore. When the spirit of exploration calls, step out onto the 18-mile Timpoochee Trail, where you can walk, bike, or jog along 30A, discovering charming communities, local shops, and inviting restaurants. Whether you’re here to unwind, reset, or reconnect, DRIFTWOOD PLACE is your peaceful home away from home. Come find your quiet space on 30A. TRANSPORTATION - Biking is a popular mode of transportation! This home has 2 bikes for your use. Should you require more during your stay, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Large heated (Winter months) resort style pool - Easy walk to beach access - Easy walk to Timpoochee Trail BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by two local vendors; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8) - Primary Suite - 2nd Floor: King bed, NEW private bathroom with walk-in shower and sitting area with morning kitchen - King Bedroom - 1st floor: King bed, NEW private bathroom with walk-in shower - Bunk Room - 1st floor: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, New bathroom with walk-in shower FEATURES: - New primary suite and bathrooms - 3 Bedroom/3 Bathroom Cottage- Sleeps 8 - 2 Adult Bikes - Work space - Private large screened porch off living/dining area - Full Sized Washer Dryer - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full Size - appliances - Charcoal Grill - Complimentary Wifi - Large HEATED (Winter) Community Pool only steps away - Parking for 2 cars in driveway - Close Proximity to the beach - neighborhood is directly across 30A from beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Seaside - The outdoor shed houses amenities for your use - beach chairs, wagons, toys and a cooler. NeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a quaint neighborhood along 30A between Rosemary/Alys and Seagrove/Seaside. Walkable to many places, easy bike ride to more, and a short car ride to any and everything you need!TransitSee above - foot, bike or a short car ride!
